title: Usage proration & plan-discount reconciler for token billing
creator: Maya Patel
description:
Goal: Build a deterministic reconciler job that applies customer plan discounts, proration rules, and usage-tier overrides to raw token metering events and emits finalized billing line items and audit records. This job sits between the ingestion/streaming meter and the billing ledger export used by Finance and should address retrospective adjustments (credits), multi-route attribution, timezone/windowed prorations for mid-cycle plan changes, and reserved vs burst capacity costing differentials.

Key constraints: idempotent processing, full audit trail per token-range, support for large accounts (50k+ daily requests), latency target: run completes within 30 minutes for daily batch, ability to re-run for historical windows without double-crediting.

Why now: increasing number of customers on tiered/committed plans has exposed edge cases where raw token counts do not map cleanly to invoiceable line items (e.g., customer upgraded mid-cycle, applied promo codes, or had mixed dedicated/hosted usage). Finance needs reliable reconciled outputs and SRE needs clear failure modes to avoid tombstoned credits.
acceptance_criteria: Reconciler produces a per-customer set of billing line items for a given daily window with applied discounts/prorations that sum to the Finance ledger feed format
Supports mid-cycle plan changes: when a plan change occurs, reconciler prorates usage across old/new price bands deterministically using customer's billing timezone
Multi-route/multi-model requests are attributed based on configured attribution priority and result in a single billed line item (no double-counting), with the attribution decision logged
Retrospective adjustments: job can emit credit line items for already-invoiced windows and a re-run does not duplicate credits (idempotency keys preserved)
Job exposes metrics: reconciled_tokens, adjustment_credits_emitted, reconciliation_latency_seconds, failed_accounts_count; alerts fire if failed_accounts_count > 5 in a day
All reconciler output rows contain an audit reference to the source events (stream_ingest_batch_id) and the reconciler_run_id
Integration tests cover: overlapping plan-change windows, promo-code discounts, reserved-pool consumption vs burst, and timezone edge cases (UTC offset boundaries)
SRE runbook updated with rollback/retry steps and an emergency manual correction playbook
action_items: Design mapping table for plan tiers, promo codes, and proration formula (PM + Finance) - owner: Lucas
Prototype reconciler transform using daily parquet read of meter_events and existing pricing-service API - owner: Priya Kaur
Add idempotent run_id + account_id dedupe layer and transactional commit to billing-ledger kafka topic - owner: Data Platform
Implement end-to-end integration test in CI that replays synthetic plan-change traces - owner: QA
Create a lightweight dashboard in Console showing reconciled vs raw token delta for top 200 accounts - owner: Analytics
Schedule a cross-team review with Finance and Billing compliance before release - owner: Maya
comments: 2026-03-02 Lucas Huang: Spiked a PoC in a notebook that joins meter_events -> customer_plans -> promos. Proration math looks straightforward for full-day switches but we need a deterministic approach for intra-day upgrades (use seconds since local midnight).

2026-03-04 Priya Kaur: Confirmed pricing-service has necessary endpoints (GET /v1/pricing/{plan} and /v1/promos/{code}); added caching for plan lookups to keep reconciler fast. PR: github.com/redwood-inc/reconciler/pull/124

2026-03-06 Maya Patel: Finance reviewed sample outputs. They requested a separate column 'finance_billing_key' to map reconciled rows to invoice line items. Also flagged rounding rules: always round cents down for usage charges and record remainder as carry-forward credit per-account. Added to acceptance criteria.

2026-03-09 Data Platform (comment): Investigated re-run behavior. We'll use reconciler_run_id + account_id + window_start as idempotency key and write to billing-ledger topic with exactly-once semantics via Kafka transactional producer. Need to ensure consumers can handle out-of-order reconciler_run_ids.

2026-03-12 QA (comment): Wrote 6 integration test scenarios for plan-change/proration and promo stacking. Found a bug when promo lifetime crosses DST boundary; created ENG-31234 to track DST canonicalization bug in promos service.

2026-03-14 Lucas Huang: Implemented initial job scaffold in services/reconciler with config flags: --window-size-days=1, --dry-run. Deployed to staging; nightly run processed 3.2M events in 12 minutes. Opening PR for code review: github.com/redwood-inc/reconciler/pull/137
